flavor.phonemic_palette: Gothic/continental Germanic backbone (masc -s/-a, fem -o; th/dh, w; ai/au) with Frankish/OHG overlay touches (High German shift in some words, -ingen lineages); theophoric stems are the Gothic reflexes (Thulrs-, Erlanda-, Numins-) with Frankish variants (Dulro-, Erlant-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Germanic + Frankish per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Germanic + Frankish register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'alaman'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Alaman — wary clan confederation of the forest; honor, freedom.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Alaman (Germanic + Frankish) are a assertive clan confederation people seeded in forest, hills. They prize honor, freedom, family, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_cavalry, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, nature, storms.
